title: Complimentary Room Night Credit on Group Room Blocks
content:
A Group Room Blocks group earns one complimentary room night for every block-type ratio of paid room nights of pickup, counted cumulatively over the whole block where the block type earns cumulatively, rounded down to whole room nights, up to the block type's maximum. Paid room nights are the block's pickup, counted under the Group Room Blocks pickup count. Each complimentary room night is credited to the master account at the group rate, without tax where the block type's credit excludes room tax.

Complimentary credits are posted only once the block's status is actualized, once per block. The credit can reduce the master balance to zero but is never paid out in cash.

### The credit in three quantities

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Complimentary room nights | the pickup divided by the ratio, rounded down to whole room nights, never more than the maximum |
| Credit | the complimentary room nights times the group rate |
| Timing | once, after the block is actualized |

### Worked credits (hypothetical block type with a ratio of 40 and a maximum of 10, group rate 165.00 USD)

| Pickup | Pickup divided by 40 | Rounded down | After the maximum | Credit (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 330 | 8.25 | 8 | 8 | 1,320.00 |
| 39 | 0.975 | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| 500 | 12.5 | 12 | 10 | 1,650.00 |
